topic: Ottawa rules and radiograph request appropriateness
usual_baseline: About half of requests meet the rules. Ottawa compliance 59.5% overall, ankle 33.1% [1661]; ankle 43%, foot 32% [1690]; OAR referenced in 37% [1715]. Knee criteria documented in 41% [1695]. GP knee films: 50% within RCR guidelines, 87% changed nothing [1766].
fix_that_works: Multi-channel teaching with posters, leaflets and emails. Compliance 59.5% to 85%, ankle 33.1% to 75.8% [1661]. Knee criterion documented 41% to 91% [1695]. Foot documentation 48% to 78% [1690]. Radiographer briefings: OAR referenced 37% to 51% [1715].
fix_that_fails: Knee compliance 72.5% to 83.5%, not significant, below 95% target [1714]. Informing GPs left the knee X-ray referral rate unchanged [1766]. Foot and ankle request compliance only reached 54–57% [1690]. Under-55s lag behind [1661].
consultant_advice: Done many times; teaching works but plateaus below target. Don't repeat an education-only cycle. Test an electronic request prompt or radiographer vetting, and measure negative X-ray rate, not just documentation.
